description: Sandbox cleanup occurs per configured policy: 'delete-on-success' removes artifacts within 5 minutes, 'retain-for-review' preserves for the configured retention period before automatic cleanup.

preconditions.description: An evaluation completes or a retention period expires

expectedOutcome.description: computeCleanupSchedule produces correct expiration times: 5 minutes for delete-on-success, retentionDays for retain-for-review. isArtifactExpired correctly identifies expired entries.
